clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Guard Parker sends a bouquet to thank Darcy for packing his lunch. Martie Jainrose gathers the flowers, and their choice stirs gossip between the two women.

Guard Parker wants to thank Darcy at the Lakeshire inn for packing his daily lunch. He asks the town herbalist, Martie Jainrose, to prepare a bouquet of daffodils. Martie says they are her favorite flowers. Darcy recognizes them as Martie’s signature bloom and suspects jealousy. Half-joking, she wonders whether Martie poisoned the stems out of spite.
